title: The Current rule of the office
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：current　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 current 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the trader wrote of ① a current rule of the office in the list, and everybody in the market said at once that it was ② more current than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the trader, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the current ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most current rule of the office anybody in the market had ever seen, or so the list for October 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too current to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the partner who had come to help; the current ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a current fashion among the young, and said that no partner in his right mind would call it ⑥ as current as the fashion among the young they had once had in the old market. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was current or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something current, and nothing besides. The partner from the next market called the whole plan ⑧ quite current; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the current ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, in silence, she wrote of another current rule of the office in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more current than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most current fashion among the young in the whole market, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the current ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 当前（前置定语 a current rule of the office：1957 年货商在货单里记下的那件当前的规矩）
B. adj. 当前／流行（比较级 more current than：文中两处，一处比办公室现行的规矩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 当前／流行（最高级 the most current：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 当前（表语 too current to do：母亲觉得它太当前，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 流行（前置定语 a current fashion among the young：叔叔把整件事称作一桩流行的风尚）
F. adj. 流行（同级比较 as current as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩年轻人中的风尚相比）
G. adj. 流行（后置定语 something current：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 流行（受程度副词修饰 quite current：那位伙计的评价）

items.q: a current rule of the office
the most current rule of the office anybody
a current fashion among the young
The most current fashion among the young in

answers.why: current 意为“当前”，1957 年货商在货单里记下的是“一件当前的规矩”，此处作前置定语 a current rule of the office。
current 意为“当前”，此处用比较级 more current than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
current 意为“当前”，货单上 十月 那行字说它是集市里最当前的一件，故用最高级 the most current rule of the office。
current 意为“当前”，母亲认为这件东西“太当前了，谁也用不上”，too current to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
current 意为“流行”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩流行的风尚”，此处作前置定语 a current fashion among the young。
current 意为“流行”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩年轻人中的风尚一样流行”，同级比较用 as current as。
current 意为“流行”，货单上那半行字要的是“流行的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something current。
current 意为“流行”，邻集市来的那位伙计认为这套计划“相当流行”，quite 修饰原级 current。
current 意为“流行”，1967 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要流行”，故用比较级 more current than。
current 意为“流行”，母亲 1969 年说的是“整个集市里最流行的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most current fashion among the young。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，货商在货单里记下了一件当前的规矩。（a current rule of the office）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更当前。（more current than …）
母亲觉得它太当前，谁也用不上。（too current to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩流行的风尚。（a current fashion among the young）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩年轻人中的风尚一样流行。（as current as …）
到了 1964 年，货单上只剩半行字：要的是一件流行的东西。（something current）
answers: In 1957 the trader wrote of a current rule of the office in the list.
Everybody said it was more current than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too current to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a current fashion among the young.
He said nobody would call it as current as the fashion among the young they had once had.
By 1964 the list asked for nothing but something current.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 current 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the trader wrote of a current rule of the office in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most current rule of the office in the market, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too current to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a current fashion among the young, and nobody argued with him.
The partner from the next market called the plan quite current, and everybody laughed.
The current ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
